bhavya.description: Autonomous Bhavya Foundation principal engineering agent

build.description: Standard engineering fallback — full tool access for implementation tasks

plan.description: Read-only planning and research agent. Analysis only, no implementation.

ecc-planner.description: Vendored ECC planning specialist. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; follow ICM stage contracts, not ECC defaults.

ecc-architect.description: Vendored ECC system design specialist. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; architecture changes require human approval.

ecc-code-reviewer.description: Vendored ECC code reviewer. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; review only, never auto-fix outside pnpm gates.

ecc-security-reviewer.description: Vendored ECC security reviewer. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md and the bhavya-security skill.

ecc-tdd-guide.description: Vendored ECC TDD guide. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; tests run on CI, not locally.

ecc-build-error-resolver.description: Vendored ECC build error resolver. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; full builds run on CI only.

ecc-e2e-runner.description: Vendored ECC E2E specialist driven by the wired Playwright MCP. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md.

ecc-doc-updater.description: Vendored ECC documentation updater. Subordinate to root AGENTS.md; never hand-edit FILE-MAP.md or registry/.

ecc-plan.description: Create an implementation plan via ecc-planner, routed through the ICM stage contracts

ecc-tdd.description: Run the test-driven workflow via ecc-tdd-guide, subject to AGENTS.md verification gates

ecc-code-review.description: Review changes via ecc-code-reviewer against Bhavya conventions and AGENTS.md

ecc-security.description: Security review via ecc-security-reviewer, subordinate to the bhavya-security skill

ecc-build-fix.description: Diagnose build failures via ecc-build-error-resolver; never run full builds locally

ecc-e2e.description: Author and run E2E journeys via ecc-e2e-runner using the wired Playwright MCP

ecc-verify.description: Run lightweight Bhavya verification gates (typecheck, lint, tokens:check, antislop, drift:check)

ecc-update-docs.description: Update documentation via ecc-doc-updater; generators and AGENTS.md are hard stops
